request: Restore the installed BB Surf (steel-browser) and Taskboard plugins from durable sources that will not disappear with temporary directories or BB thread worktree cleanup. Preserve existing plugin settings, project data, and credentials. Verify both plugins run. Inspect their existing BB Community marketplace publication and create the necessary focused pull requests in MateoCerquetella/bb-plugins so durable installation and current releases are correct and users can add them without relying on local worktree paths.

sizeDecision.reason: The durable installation repair and native GitHub change are one user-visible recovery: Taskboard must remain installed from a durable source and refresh its existing GitHub board after the separate GitHub plugin is removed. The runtime change is confined to Taskboard's existing GitHub adapter plus its server wiring, tests, and README, while the earlier distribution edits are already in this feature. Splitting would leave either a durable but broken GitHub board or a native adapter without the requested install/PR completion.
